name: Viewlify
description: Hosted Viewlify MCP for public TikTok data: which videos beat their creator's usual views (the outlier multiple), trending videos, hashtags and sounds by niche, shares per 1,000 views and view history. Without a key, get_trending, get_outliers and get_trending_hashtags return a 5-result preview; full search, balance and top-up need a Viewlify API key, which this registry entry does not configure.
author: Viewlify
